ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95:5 dark-to-light, restricted to localized high-intensity pixels at the fluke base and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-gray contiguous region across both lobes. A high-contrast white cluster is visible at the central base (peduncle junction), with sparse white flecking localized along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees and a narrow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; notable large-amplitude notch located on the inner third of the right lobe trailing edge; continuous micro-peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve along the upper trailing edge transitioning to tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, heterogeneous pixel groups (brown/white) at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible biological colonization (barnacles) at both lobe tips; significant irregular indentation on the right lobe's trailing edge.
